_comment: Applied by the shell at load (screen_form_module.rs apply_overrides). Keys: field key k (label/kind/options/computed; table columns are keyed by the column's row-0 key); item:<partIndex>:<itemIndex> for item labels (0-based into forms-schema.json parts/items); table:<part>:<name> builds a schedule table from row templates; add:<part>:<item> appends bound controls the extractor left out; move:<field key> with to '<part>:<item>' or '<part>:new:<no>' (+ item {l, order}) regroups a control under its printed item. Every entry carries its evidence.

frm1606:txtTaxRate.label: Tax rate
frm1606:txtTaxRate.evidence: D03: Item 31 is chosen by the filer, not computed. Official BIR-Form1606.hta: select titled "Please select Tax Rate" with "" Select Tax Rate, 0 0%, 1.5 1.5%, 3 3%, 5 5%, 6 6%, enabled for the filer. form_1606.rs stores it as tax_rate (Form1606TaxRate) and requires it ("Please select the tax rate on Item 31."). The rules corpus marks it computed; probe::USER_CHOSEN corrects the projection and the binding is derived. The blank official choice is the page's empty choice (clears tax_rate).
